text_block_list.text:
The next day. It had turned suddenly cold 
since the previous night, leaving a thick 
blanket of snow.

The snow on the training track had been 
cleared away by the groundskeepers. It 
looked like training wouldn't be a problem 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, you're here already.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm not running!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm not running, no way, no way! I don't 
feel like running at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmphhhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what those girls are doing 
huddling at the edge of the track...?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like that person is being run 
ragged by their trainee's selfishness. I'm 
guessing she threw a tantrum again today.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? The snow's only going to get heavier 
from here... What if they catch a cold?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, it's a real worry. 
Especially since the opponent is still 
just a little kid.

Beside me, she exhaled and warmed her 
fingertips, enduring the cold.

"If you went through the trouble of 
changing and coming all the way out here, 
it'd be much faster to just run—"
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if there's a reason she doesn't 
want to run?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What are you staring at?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If you've got something to say, spit it 
out already. Just like all the other 
adults."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Things like, "You should run for the sake 
of your future," or "If you have no 
intention of running, you might as well go 
home."
choice_data_list:
Still, it sounds like you have your own 
reasons too.
But it seems you have your own reasons too

text_block_list.text:
"If they had no desire to run in the first 
place, they wouldn't have even shown up to 
training."

Even so, she's continued to show up for 
training this whole time. In that case, 
there's no need to doubt her motivation.
choice_data_list:
That's why I want to believe in that and 
wait.

text_block_list.text:
While waiting for Sweep Tosho, snow began 
to lightly flutter down from the sky.

I brushed the snow from my shoulders. The 
melted snow was slowly spreading into a 
damp patch on my clothes.

The snow grew stronger at times, and 
paused briefly at others. Beneath the 
capricious sky, as I sat on the track 
beside her—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiaaar!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run! Time me, please!

With boundless lightness, she accelerates 
as if slicing right through the air.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!
(Murmur murmur...!)

I wasn't the only one captivated by Sweep 
Tosho's running. A murmur of excitement 
could be heard all around.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*... *gasp*... ngh, *pant*... 
*gasp*... *inhale*~~~."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I want to discover the magic of racing! 
That's why I want to run in big races!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I already know what to do without being 
told 'do this, do that'! It's not like I 
haven't been thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
They're all just so annoying, bossing me 
around like they own the place... It makes 
me so mad!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's not at all what I want... 
You just say it's for my sake...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that just makes my blood boil. 
Even though it's right before a race, I 
can't calm down at all...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's why familiars are—...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Just you, my familiar, ask me questions 
like you did before. Like, 'Is there a 
reason for this?'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Trust me properly. Listen to my opinion.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Don't try to hold me back by telling me 
'this way is right'... !"
choice_data_list:
You have your own sense of what's right, 
after all.

You have your own sense of what's right, 
too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I want to find the magic in 
racing, so I want to do my best every 
single day...!

As I watched over her training, the snow 
had stopped before I even noticed.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Familiar, a moment.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Earlier, I was just testing you to see 
if you were lying when you said you 
believed in me."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You... well, you pass. So, as a reward, 
I'll cast some special magic on you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle, twinkle☆ Become even more of a 
familiar to love!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph, this should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
With my magic, you've just leveled up as 
my familiar! That makes you just a tiiiiny 
bit more important than before, you know!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Unlike other familiars, I became special 
enough to be Master's trusted confidante.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right. ...So listen to me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma told me a story. She said, 
"Great-Grandma used magic in that race 
too."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I found it in a book! It said 
the Great Witch who's best friends with 
the Great Fairy wears a tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Idiot! What are you hesitating for?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
With how the conversation's going, this is 
where you're supposed to suggest, "If it's 
for the Oka Sho, this kind of training is 
recommended," right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You numbskull carrot! You're Kawakami's 
familiar, so read your master's mind at 
least!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I order you to do something, 
you'd better have the next two steps 
planned out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Did you get it?! Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, tell me already. What kind of 
training do I need to do for the Oka Sho?

Urged on by Sweep Tosho, I lined up right 
beside her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And you deal with all the adults who come 
nagging before the race, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There better be tasty juice in the waiting 
room or I'll be so mad! And then, and 
then...!

The moment I stepped up beside her, she 
immediately showered me with demands for 
what her "familiar" should do.

Together with my selfish master, our first 
goal for next year is the Oka Sho.
